'''Calimondretta''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] that was located on the frozen [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Syned]], in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]]. It was constructed from the Synedian ice, and was controlled by the [[Arkadianate]], a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] state that was led by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Arkadia Calimondra]]. During the [[Siege of Calimondretta]] in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], the city suffered extensive damage during an escape attempt by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]], the [[Brigadier]] [[Jarrow Rusher]], and the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Narsk Ka'hane]]. During the chaos, five hundred Arkadianate citizens deserted Arkadia, seeking refuge aboard the [[Diligence (New Sith Wars)|''Diligence'']].
